train_robust_model: train verifiably robust NLP models with interval bound propagation on tasks like SST, SNLI, MNLI, or SICK
run_analysis: run robustness analysis on a trained model to evaluate nominal and verified accuracy across dataset splits
construct_synonyms: construct synonym lookup structures from a JSON synonym file for adversarial perturbation during training
linear_schedule: linearly schedule a parameter from an initial value to a final value over a range of training steps
config_train_summary: configure TensorBoard summary operations for training accuracy and loss metrics
